caption: The drawing is in black and white, showing three separate objects. At the top, there is a round, mirror-like object held upright by two abstract, flame or leaf-shaped forms on either side; these forms are mounted on a flat horizontal base. Below this, in the center, is a cylindrical holder with one open side, also decorated with abstract, flame-like motifs projecting upward from a rectangular base. To the right, the word "COIN" is labeled above a circular coin; the coin features an engraved image of a seated figure holding a staff, with indistinct details and an inscription that is difficult to read. The drawing is rendered with shading and highlights to show depth and form, and is set against a plain, light-colored background.
title: Silver Napkin Ring
